summary: Implemented comprehensive Python executor window-function support. Added planner window stages, named-window resolution, grouped aggregate extraction, QUALIFY handling, and correct ordering relative to WHERE/GROUP BY/HAVING/DISTINCT/ORDER BY/LIMIT. Added efficient partitioned evaluation for ranking, aggregate, navigation, ROWS/RANGE/GROUPS frames, exclusions, peer semantics, NULL handling, and IGNORE NULLS. Preserved window-bearing subqueries from unsafe optimizer unnesting and supported correlated/scalar/quantified subqueries. Also fixed set-operation branch context collisions. Validated frame/ranking/navigation behavior against SQLite where supported, exercised grouped/join/subquery/named-window composition, compiled the package, and benchmarked representative 50,000-row cases at roughly 0.8–1.0 seconds each.
